## tbx_die

```bash
tbx_die()
```

Print a message to stderr and exit with the given code.
- @arg $1 int Exit code (default 1).
- @arg $@ string Message.
- @exitcode $1 Always exits with the given code.

## tbx_error

```bash
tbx_error()
```

Print an error message to stderr.
- @arg $@ string Message.

## tbx_info

```bash
tbx_info()
```

Print an informational message to stderr.
- @arg $@ string Message.

## tbx_result

```bash
tbx_result()
```

Print text to stdout. With TBX_JSON=1 the text is emitted as a JSON string.
- @arg $1 string Result text.
- @stdout The result.

## tbx_result_json

```bash
tbx_result_json()
```

Validate a JSON document and print it: compact with TBX_JSON=1, pretty otherwise.
- @arg $1 string JSON document.
- @stdout The JSON document.
- @exitcode 65 Input is not valid JSON; nothing is written to stdout.
- @exitcode 69 jq is not installed.
